meaning: Marks the topic and may imply contrast
example_reading: わたしはがくせいです
example_translation: As for me I am a student

meaning: Marks the subject or highlights new information
Marks what is acted on
Marks a time destination or recipient
Marks direction toward a place
Marks where an action happens or how it is done
example_reading: としょかんでべんきょうします

meaning: Means with or and in complete lists and marks quotations
Means also or too
Connects a possessor or description to a noun
Marks a starting point or a reason
example_reading: くじからはたらきます

meaning: Marks an endpoint in time or place
example_reading: ごじまでべんきょうします

meaning: Marks the comparison point meaning than
example_reading: これよりおおきいです

meaning: Marks a question or offers a choice
Seeks agreement or shared understanding
example_translation: The weather is nice isn't it

meaning: Emphasizes or newly informs the listener
Lists examples without claiming the list is complete
example: りんごやバナナを買います
example_reading: りんごやばななをかいます
example_translation: I buy things such as apples and bananas

meaning: Limits something to only the stated item
Means only when used with a negative expression
example_reading: ひゃくえんしかありません
example_translation: I have only one hundred yen

meaning: Can mean even or soften a suggestion depending on context
example: お茶でも飲みませんか
example_reading: おちゃでものみませんか
example_translation: Would you like some tea or something

meaning: Introduces informal examples rather than a complete list
example: りんごとかを買います
example_reading: りんごとかをかいます
